title.value: EU-PS-L3-A - Level 3a: Maximum metadata en minimale secties (eu-core entries)

description.value: The serving system provides an EU-PS for its level 3a test patient, in which every mandatory section has a narrative summary and structured entries. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 3a test patient, and only to that patient. Implementation Guide: https://build.fhir.org/ig/hl7-eu/eps/
